author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Hello.

By the end of this week, the map development team will have a finalized rotation for Mix, Destroy, and Deathmatch. We will be planning to update every rotation every two to four weeks to get rid of stale rotations. However, before we update the rotations, we would like to obtain your voice on this matter. What maps do you want to see in the rotation? Are there maps you want removed? For these questions, we would like a minimum of 10 maps in a rotation and a maximum of 18.


A couple of remarks:


- Make a list of 10-18 maps for any rotation


- We will include at most ONLY ONE throwback map (Ternio, Quintus, Rigor, Fantasy, Wonderland, Venomous, Rapture2, Ravanged, BrokenWorld, CastleAdventure, Frostbite, Mystic, Zalidor, Volcano) per rotation. Any maps not stated in this list are fair game and have no limit. Any map ending with the suffix "Origins" will not be considered.

- Each map should come with a brief description on why you believe it should be in rotations

- You can suggest maps from "Map Testing" as well. (With proper reasoning)


You can find a list of maps at http://avicus.net/maps or at http://maps.avicus.net/atlas

Please take this seriously. Any inappropriate or unnecessary comments will be disregarded and possibly archived.

Note:
Destroy = DTM/DTC
Mix = DTM/DTC/CTW/CTF/KOTH/TDM/Nexus
Deathmatch = TDM/Nexus


Thank you
- The Map Development Team

replies.author: profbananaslug
replies.body:
i'm going to take this the other way and list off the maps i don't want to see in the rotation, because i guess i'm just more of a cynical person

1. castle adventure
this map has you doing one of two things: bridge and get shot off, or stand around and shoot people off bridges. eventually, someone will manage to sneak behind the other team's base (not hard to do considering that there's high towers with bridges to sneak around on, where you'll never get spotted because no one ever goes up in them and video game players never seem to look up) and mine a monument (or often monuments) in full view since they're chronically undefended. also has the dubious honor of being the gayest map on avicus.

2. phendralalala sanctuary
notable for being one of the only ctw maps that ever gets played on pubs, and also always ending without fail in under five minutes. i have seen matches on coretest te go on longer than any match that i've ever had on phendrama sanctuary. i talked to _distraction_ about the map's continued inclusion in rotations, and he said it's because the map is """defensible""" and """has a good layout""", but i've played quite a few matches on that map and seen people defend a grand total of 0 times. apparently, the map is kept in despite the fact that it plays horribly because it's the player's fault for not defending, and not the map's. i was also told that map makers can't ""make""" people defend, so it looks like it's a classic case of "should work in theory, but doesn't really in practice" and the map devs seem to be unable to come to terms with this fact. i think this is also the map with the longest respawn time in public servers, with a grand total of five seconds, which always makes me groan when i die because i'd almost managed to forget about it.

3. arida
pretty much team grief: the map, i always see at least one person get punished for it per match. it also doesn't help that most of the map is built with blocks with good blast resistance like sandstone. curiously, it also has a mid, which might explain why i never see anyone using the tnt to build cannons. all in all, it's an okay map that is made worse by the seemingly-random inclusion of tnt.

4. luar retarded
i swear this has been in the rotations non-stop since january, and every time i log in it feels like the map that's being played is luar. it's gotten to the point where even the mere thought of playing yet another game on luar makes my eyes roll all the way back into my head where i can see my brain cells dying en masse. 

5. rendezvous redux
an insult to all that is rendezvous. give us the original rendezvous. 

6. tasty fight
probably one of the largest and most confusing (due to the use of rotational instead of reflectional symmetry) maps on avicus, and no worse for it (just kidding, it is). i'm only familiar with one of the monuments (primarily because i've never been able to find the other), but it's pretty damn hard to defend, being pretty far from spawn and floating in mid-air and whatnot. usually has pretty quick games, given of course that you've got rushers who can even find the monuments.

7. dust devils (both versions)
one of those classic maps that's over in either 1 minute or 1 hour that devolves to a kind of orwellian stalemate after a while where players on each team attack the opposing team's monument one at a time and get slaughtered by 5-10 defenders, who occupy themselves while not being attacked by building the kinds of elaborate defenses that are worthy of a post-game screenshot. eventually, i suppose the game ends when one team's defender's eyes get so bleary from fatigue that they can no longer hit anything, and a rare concentrated push of rushers manages to overwhelm them. i mostly amuse myself by digging around the enemy team's defense and harassing them with water buckets or occasionally killing them, since i've got no chance of getting the monument, but even all that has gotten old now. the avd version has a whole host of issues as well, mostly stemming from the asymmetric gameplay, that i won't even bother getting into because i don't think anyone will seriously consider it for a rotation anyway. on a distantly related note, sweet slopes has too much verticality.

8. ponylands 2/2.5
boring

9. quintus duo
basically an oxymoron, just put in good ol' quintus for fuck's sake

10. system divide
another ctw map i've seen in a few rots on pubs, and curiously has the exact same issue regarding defense as phenoxytyl sanctuary does despite resembling it in no way. also features a villager killstreak rewards system, which i haven't really seen used because the game is always over so fast. 

anyways, i would also like to point out that there doesn't seem to be much of a correlation between maps that the community finds fun and maps that the map devs think are good.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I almost forgot Diamond Shore existed. It was a fun map, but the items available were comparable, if not worse than Rapture in terms of how overpowered they were. I wouldn't be opposed to readding it if there was more incentive for defending the other monuments rather than the one by spawn, and if the map had more spacial disparity. A lot seemed crammed, and I also think there should be a limit on how high skybridges can go.

But, all in all, it was a pretty ace map and unique.
